supersedes_nothing: E0003 and the v1-v4 packets are preserved historical records and are not modified.
question: When both arms rank candidates with the same Python code, does the BRIDGE LAB pipeline choose a better ranking method than one model call?

harness.description: BRIDGE LAB pipeline: Problem Structurer, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology Validator, Transfer Judge, then Python ranking.
harness.build_status: BUILT AND TESTED OFFLINE: replaying a real recorded run through run_pipeline_v2 reproduces its Judge output; a drug_cell_mean Judge output is accepted and executed (server/test_e0004.py). Never run against a live model.
harness.entry_point: bridgelab/harness_v2.py (run_pipeline_v2); orchestration_v2 is derived from orchestration.py by three asserted replacements

pipeline_settings.note: Mirrors the live caller in server/bridge_server.py. The E0003 comparison caller is not in this package, so confirm these match it before sealing. The Judge output is compiled once per frozen budget.

baseline.description: One model call chooses one allowlisted method. Python ranks with the same code as the Harness.

reference_only.description: Deterministic Python methods and random selection, reported without any claim.

split.note: The E0003 split is reused unchanged. No new split is drawn.

budgets.count_rule: Same frozen counts as E0003 (5%, 10% and 20% of the 62,510 hidden candidates).

runs.note: Each index is one independent run of each arm.

primary_metric: precision at the primary budget under intention-to-treat; a failed run scores 0

gate.per_index: comparison.evaluate_claim_gate, unchanged: primary CI lower bound > 0 and Harness strictly ahead at >= 2 of 3 budgets
gate.study_level: Superiority is claimed only if the per-index gate passes at >= 2 of the 3 run indices and no index has a primary CI favoring the baseline.
gate.tie_rule: If both arms choose the same method at an index, their selections are identical, the difference is exactly 0, and that index counts as a tie, not a failure.

hidden_labels.opened: once, after both arms finish or fail

precision_at_5_10_20_percent_mean_of_3_s.exact_pair_mean: identical ranking to drug_mean on unseen pairs
precision_at_5_10_20_percent_mean_of_3_s.pair_frequency: about 0.32, 0.34, 0.31 (seed 42), near the random rate of about 0.30

development_evidence_not_E0004_evidence.disclosure: drug_cell_mean and structure_cell_knn were added after train-only analyses on the v4 train labels. The E0003 hidden pairs were not part of them and no per-item hidden label has been seen by anyone. Two things are known about the hidden set: E0003 aggregate precision for the Harness (0.6070, 0.5769, 0.5034 at 5%, 10%, 20%), and that its labels were loaded once for E0003.
development_evidence_not_E0004_evidence.structure_cell_knn_note: Fixed before this analysis was finished: K=30, power 2, alpha 0.5 (alpha 1.0 was the only other value tried and was slightly worse at every budget). It beat drug_cell_mean in all 3 seeds at all 3 budgets.

rdkit: Fingerprints depend on the RDKit version; record it in the ledger when the Harness runs (installed: 2025.09.2).
